changelog:
- Initial release: fetches comprehensive Airbnb listing details via internal GraphQL API using a listing ID.
- Returns title, room type, description, amenities, photos, coordinates, city, house rules, highlights, ratings, review count, bedrooms, and property overview.
- No login required; works directly within browser context.
- Handles rate limits and provides clear error handling for invalid or removed listings.
- Price details only available if check-in and check-out dates are provided.
- Limitation: host personal info and new listing ratings may be unavailable.
summary: Fetches complete Airbnb listing details for a given numeric listing ID via the internal GraphQL API, returning title, room type, description, amenities, photos, coordinates, city, house rules, highlights, ratings, review count, bedroom configuration, and property overview. Use when user mentions Air
